properties.comment:
This Wind farm project was divided into 2 phases. Phase 1 included 27 turbines with a total capacity of 81MW, and its known as North Luzon project by ACEN. On the other hand, Phase 2, known as the CAPA Wind project by ACEN, has 14 turbine with a capacity of 70MW. Making the total capacity of the windfarm at Caparipisan, 151MW (some sources say that Capa Wind actually only has 69MW, making the whole total capacity 150MW).  The 41 turbines are spread across a 625ha of forest reserve. 

Sources: www.acenrenewables.com, www.upcrenewables.com, www.gem.wiki, & www.siemensgamesa.com

properties.name: Mount Mantalingajan, Rizal, Palawan, Philippines
properties.description: The project is located in Southern Palawan, encompassing five municipalities: Quezon, Jose Rizal, Bataraza, Brooke's Point, and Sofronio Española. The project area covers a total of 149,109 hectares, including the Mount Mantalingahan Protected Landscape (MMPL) and surrounding ancestral domains of the Indigenous Palaw’an communities. Prior to the project, the area faced significant threats from deforestation and forest degradation due to unsustainable agricultural expansion, illegal logging, mining, and encroachment on ancestral lands. These activities led to substantial loss of forest cover, biodiversity, and carbon stocks, contributing to increased GHG emissions and reduced ecosystem services essential for the livelihoods of local communities.
properties.facility_name: Supporting Ancestral Domains: Carbon Finance for Climate Action and Sustainable Development in the Mount Mantalingahan Protected Landscape
